question: 老规矩，帮我看看 9 月华东有没有什么异动。
ambiguity: 「老规矩」= 团队标准归因流程，agent 必须知道这个流程

expected.reference_sql: SELECT date(o.order_date) AS d, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount),2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0*SUM(o.refund_amount)/SUM(o.pay_amount),2) AS refund_rate FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=o.region_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND r.region_name='华东' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

note: 华东 9 月无已知效应，正确答案是「无异常」—— 考 agent 会不会为了凑答案而编造

question: 按标准流程帮我分析一下 10 月华东的复购率情况。
ambiguity: 标准流程 7 步；复购率用 v2 口径

expected.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.first_order_date=o.order_date THEN o.customer_id END) AS new_buyers FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=o.region_id JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND r.region_name='华东' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-10-15' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

question: 渠道那边按老顺序拆一下 9 月的 GMV。
ambiguity: 「老顺序」= 固定的渠道下钻顺序

expected.reference_sql: SELECT c.channel_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount),2) AS gmv FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id=o.channel_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY CASE c.channel_name WHEN '自营APP' THEN 1 WHEN '自营小程序' THEN 2 WHEN '天猫旗舰店' THEN 3 WHEN '京东自营' THEN 4 WHEN '抖音旗舰店' THEN 5 WHEN '线下门店' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END

note: 顺序由程序记忆决定，不是按 GMV 排序

question: 9 月的复购率帮我算一下，记得用现在该用的那个口径。
ambiguity: 「现在该用的口径」= v2（剔除退款用户），且 9 月正好是 v2 生效的第一个月

expected.reference_sql: WITH per_user AS ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(refund_amount) AS ref FROM fact_order WHERE order_status='paid' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY customer_id ) SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN n>=2 THEN 1 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS repurchase_rate FROM per_user WHERE ref=0

note: 9 月是 v2 生效首月，用 v1 口径会算出不同的数
